data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara1
data.value: At Air IQ, your security and privacy are fundamental. We protect your Personal Information with strong encryption and lay strict policies that govern how all data is handled.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara2
data.value: The only objective of all information that we gather and store from you is to make things convenient for you, to enable us to deliver and improve our services better and faster and to conduct our business.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara3
data.value: We make it very transparent as to what information we collect and why. All of your data is in your control. We make it clear for you to understand exactly what's going to happen to your Personal Information.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara4
data.value: You can decide what information you would like to store. And changing these preferences are quick and easy.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara5
data.value: We never indulge in any promotional or ad communication without your permission. You have absolute control over all optional communication that you receive from our end.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara6
data.value: Most importantly, we don't and will never "monetize" the information you store with us by selling or renting it to any third party and while we inevitably care about your privacy, we ensure that steps towards tight privacy do not come in the way of simplicity. That all steps towards security still ensure an unobstructed user experience.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara7
data.value: Our commitment to protecting your privacy comes from a profound desire to maintain the timeless value of privacy and preserve the ability for you to control your data. We know that your trust doesn't come easy. That's why we always work as hard as we can to earn and keep it.

data.name: PrivacyPolicyPara8
